full_details: You went to St Helen's with the house. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not speak. Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice and said the fast was ten days off, Ash Wednesday the fifth of March. At dinner the loaf was a penny and short by a finger. You paid threepence for the meal and sixpence for the week's firing and washing. The Sunday letter stayed folded for Thursday. After dinner Mistress Ansell counted her spoons and came out one short. She accused nobody. You asked which caller could make a profit from a spoon. Alse found it among the ink-things, black to the neck. Mistress Ansell said it had been put there to be found. The quarrel was an ordinary one.
one_sentence: Master Thwaite turned the glass twice and counted ten days to the fast, and after dinner Alse found the missing spoon black with ink.
title: Ten days, and one spoon short
